embeds.description:
Socket reports a coordinated supply chain attack campaign codenamed TrapDoor that distributed credential-stealing malware across npm, PyPI, and Crates.io ecosystems. The campaign spans 34 malicious packages across over 384 versions, targeting developers in crypto, DeFi, Solana, and AI communities. The malicious packages are designed to steal developer secrets, crypto wallets, SSH keys, cloud credentials, browser data, and environment variables. The attack uses ecosystem-specific execution paths including postinstall hooks in npm, build.rs scripts in Rust crates, and import-time execution in Python packages. The threat actor also attempted to introduce hidden instructions in .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md files through pull requests to popular AI and developer projects.
